items.title: John Pizzarelli, Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 1 of 2]

ctx.x: And he’d just hit them all. And you’d go oh, there they are. And you’d know if it was a D minor chord you’d hear D minor, and then you’d hear down the line D minor, C and you’d hear it all going. And you’d just sit there and he’d go, “you got it?” And he would look at me like you got it. And I’d go oh, okay. And I was so happy that he was being nice to me. And so, that was in Odessa in 1981 I think. Herb Ellis couldn’t make it and my father says, “we’ll take the kid, we’ll take him down there.” And so I found…
Well how does a young player who doesn’t have the advantage of having a father like that, do the ear thing, like you did it?
